summary: The note describes the 2017 ICC Champions Trophy, the eighth edition of the ICC tournament for the eight top-ranked One Day International cricket teams. It was held in England and Wales from 1 to 18 June 2017. Pakistan won the title for the first time, beating India by 180 runs in the final at The Oval, the largest winning margin in runs in an ICC ODI tournament final.
one_line: The 2017 ICC Champions Trophy, an eight-team ODI cricket tournament held in England and Wales, was won by Pakistan over India.
key_facts: The 2017 ICC Champions Trophy was the eighth ICC Champions Trophy.
The tournament was a cricket competition for the eight top-ranked One Day International (ODI) teams in the world.
The 2017 ICC Champions Trophy was held in England and Wales.
The tournament ran from 1 June 2017 to 18 June 2017.
Pakistan won the 2017 ICC Champions Trophy for the first time.
Pakistan beat India by 180 runs in the final of the 2017 ICC Champions Trophy.
The final of the 2017 ICC Champions Trophy was played at The Oval.
The margin of victory in the 2017 ICC Champions Trophy final was the largest by any team in an ICC ODI tournament final in terms of runs.
